channel.title: Line by Line
channel.description: A Scripture & Exegesis Podcast searching God's Word verse by verse. item.title: Psalm 1: The Two Ways and the Planted Tree
item.description: In the second episode of Line by Line, host Rebecca introduces the canonical role of Psalm 1 as the gateway to the entire Psalter from a conservative Reformed perspective. Then, James delivers a line-by-line exposition of the Hebrew text and classic commentaries of John Calvin, Matthew Henry, Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, and Charles Spurgeon, contrasting the progressive downward descent of the wicked with the deeply rooted vitality of the blessed man, culminating in Christ the true Tree of Life.

item.title: Psalm 23: The Shepherd and His Sheep
item.description: In the inaugural episode of Line by Line, host Rebecca establishes the covenantal and historical setting of David's most beloved psalm from a conservative Reformed perspective. Then, James walks line-by-line through the Hebrew text and classic commentaries of John Calvin, Matthew Henry, and Charles Spurgeon, unpacking Yahweh Rohi, the valley of the shadow of death, the prepared table, and the eternal security of Christ's flock.
